That helper throws when `safeParse` fails (`throw new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")`), so the failure mode is now an exception rather than a logged error + continuation. This is a real, diff-grounded behavior change that could affect existing callers, though it’s not necessarily an outright defect.
